literal_meaning: মুখে দুধের গন্ধ (smell of milk in the mouth)
figurative_meaning_en: young age or still a child
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এখনও মুখে দুধের গন্ধ, এত বড় দায়িত্ব নিতে পারবে না।
বাচ্চাটা মুখে দুধের গন্ধ নিয়ে খেলছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He still has the smell of milk in his mouth; he can't take on such a big responsibility.
The child is playing with the smell of milk still in his mouth.
note: Refers to the natural smell of milk from infants, symbolizing tenderness and immaturity in Bengali folklore and daily speech.
